protocol.question: Does the nominated production-linked clock reduce cold process execution CPU in the real Aonohako ordinary worker on one Seoul Cloud Run instance?
protocol.verification: Per arm require exact externally known worker/source/client/runtime identity, CPUID x86-64-v2, actual immutable image ID and runtime-options binding, the same weighted budget, ordinary 3 counters, generous outer CPU/wall and score/output/exit at normal completion. Independently compute crossed work from observed progress for every response. Label full inc. any count mismatch separately; no removal of noisy measurements. Live killed work is a progress prefix, not a full program total.

design.sampling: A block is four consecutive requests, ABBA or BAAB with alternating orientation within case; both arms have the same mean position in a block. Spread each case across 12 epochs using floor(12*i/block_count). Sort scheduled names by SHA-256(seed/epoch/name). Every launched process fresh on one warm, private Seoul Cloud Run Gen2 instance. This measures process startup and full execution.
design.estimand: Geometric mean candidate/baseline CPU ratio within the four requests. Report median across blocks, every block and sign; nominal >=95% order-statistic interval when enough blocks; this assumes independent blocks with a common median. Also report wall/CPU arm medians, ranges and all observations. No post-hoc rejection, discarding cold observations, coefficient refitting or pooling across inputs.

package_link.compiler: GCC 14 / GNU objcopy 2.44 against the shipped patched DynamoRIO SDK and release core

timing: Aonohako cpu_time_ns and wall_time_ms for one submitted metered execution. Signed differences are candidate minus baseline in matching case and round. Aborted work is a progress prefix.
